entry_condition: Release is controlled or bounded enough for protective-action management.
operational_decisions: maintain shelter/evacuation;worker exposure control;public warning;initial monitoring;medical triage
required_evidence: incident status;dose projection;field measurements;public instruction log;worker dose controls
cannot_close_until: protective-action status, monitoring responsibilities, and public information cadence are stable

entry_condition: Authorities need temporary access to relocation/restricted areas for lifesafety, animal care, utilities, monitoring, or critical property protection.
operational_decisions: who can reenter;for what tasks;time/dose limits;PPE/dosimetry;escort/security;exit monitoring
required_evidence: reentry authorization form;dose constraints;route and task list;briefing record;exit contamination checks
affected_public_protection: no ad hoc VIP or employer pressure; worker refusal and safety rights protected
cannot_close_until: temporary reentry logs and exposure records reconcile with dose controls

entry_condition: People cannot safely remain or return while assessment, cleanup, or utilities decisions continue.
required_evidence: relocation eligibility;case management;benefits portability;school and medical transfer protocols
affected_public_protection: do not force return by withholding support; preserve records, benefits, and family unity
cannot_close_until: basic needs and relocation claims are funded, reachable, and appealable

entry_condition: Contamination assessment indicates cleanup, waste handling, or land-use controls may be needed.
operational_decisions: cleanup objectives;community involvement;waste characterization;contractor QA;worker safety;sampling plan
required_evidence: cleanup plan;sampling QA/QC;waste pathway;community involvement record;contract/procurement controls
affected_public_protection: community has a voice in cleanup choices; no invisible transfer of risk to disposal or worker communities
cannot_close_until: cleanup criteria, waste pathway, and community involvement are approved and public-safe

entry_condition: Potential ingestion-pathway contamination exists or sampling is incomplete.
operational_decisions: embargo/release;alternate drinking water;milk/food/fish/game controls;lab prioritization;producer compensation
required_evidence: sampling chain-of-custody;lab capacity;public-health advisory;alternate water logistics;producer/worker support
affected_public_protection: avoid uncompensated economic coercion that encourages unsafe product movement
cannot_close_until: food/water decisions, alternate supply, and compensation/appeal paths are working

entry_condition: People may be contaminated, exposed, worried about exposure, or part of the response workforce.
required_evidence: population monitoring center data;registry criteria;privacy impact review;follow-up instructions;responder roster
affected_public_protection: include people who think they may be exposed; protect privacy and prevent stigma
cannot_close_until: monitoring, tracking, referral, and follow-up instructions are complete enough for audit

entry_condition: Evacuation, relocation, business interruption, property, health-monitoring, or cleanup harms create claims.
operational_decisions: claim intake;documentation alternatives;advance payments;appeals;language/disability access;fraud controls
required_evidence: claims rules;public portal;offline intake;appeal process;case status;equity audit
affected_public_protection: do not make harmed people prove impossible records lost during evacuation
cannot_close_until: claims access and appeals are public, staffed, and tested with vulnerable groups

entry_condition: Cleanup/reentry decisions are mature enough to consider return, permanent relocation, land-use limits, or closeout.
operational_decisions: return criteria;residual risk communication;land-use controls;monitoring cadence;counterevidence handling;lessons learned
required_evidence: final status maps;monitoring plan;counterevidence closure;after-action nonrecurrence plan;public meeting record
affected_public_protection: public can challenge dose/pathway assumptions and request review of anomalies
cannot_close_until: open counterevidence, monitoring anomalies, or unresolved claims are dispositioned
